# Objective

Ship nine user-requested overlay changes in one batch (one CI drop at the end):

| # | Ask | Resolution (as built) |
|---|-----|----------------------|
| 1 | Show the actual clickable points inside the zone boxes (level 1) | Per-point dots in `HintCanvas.RenderGroupVisual` |
| 2 | One border line between boxes, not two | Zone-grid path: single outer rect + interior separators drawn once (`ZoneGridCols/Rows` DPs) |
| 3 | `GroupZones` 5×5 → 4×6 | Default change across config/options/comments |
| 4 | `i` = insert mode (suspend), `q`/`Esc` exits | Reserve `I` like `Q` (24-letter alphabet); hook intercepts Esc/Q while suspended |
| 5 | Close after v/d/s completes | Snapshot follows `SelectionActionsClose` (Double/Triple/v already do) |
| 6 | Always-on quadrant guide I/O/J/K | Persistent click-through `QuadrantGuideWindow` per monitor; hotkeys stay F1–F4 (letters = user's AHK layer) |
| 7 | Portrait monitors: in-zone 4×6 not 6×4 | `TryDeriveZoneGrid` best-factorization vs aspect |
| 8 | Leader popup + badge don't scale on high-res | `ApplyChromeScale` LayoutTransform (DIU height / 1080, clamp ≥ 1) |
| 9 | hap "stops working" on elevated apps (v2rayN) | SendInput click synthesis with injected-count check + BLOCKED badge/log; RegisterHotKey failure + duplicate-instance MessageBoxes; startup elevation log |

# Key decisions (user-confirmed)

- `I` is reserved (removed from `HintCharacters`) so plain `i` always enters
  insert mode — dim toggle moves to `<leader>x`. Numeric coherence: 24 letters
  ↔ 4×6 = 24 zone keys × 6×4 = 24 in-zone labels = 576 = 24² labels.
- The quadrant guide is **always visible** (persistent window), labels
  I/O/J/K from `QuadrantGuideLabels`; hap hotkeys stay `Ctrl+Shift+F1..F4`.

# Approach per item

- Dots at `(br.Left, br.Top)` for PointHints (that IS the cursor target);
  group visual re-renders on `HintsSource` change (binding-order fix).
- Zone-grid borders: extent = union of box bounds; ONE outer rounded rect
  inflated by `GroupBoxPad`; separators at `extent.Left + c*(W/cols)` once;
  same cell math as `TryAssignZoneLabels`. v1 fallback path unchanged.
- Best-fit factorization: candidates `(c, n/c)` for `c = 1..n`, pick
  `min |c/r − aspect|`, ascending-c strict tie-break; 20px legibility floor
  clamps unchanged. Landscape 6×4 / portrait 4×6 / square 5×5; 2-char
  landscape flips 1×2 → 2×1 (test updated with rationale).
- Insert mode: `VK_I` classified before label chars (beside `VK_Q`);
  `Shift+I` remains the Large nudge-**down** chord (U,I,O,P = L,D,U,R);
  `Ctrl+I`/`Win+I` pass through. `EnterSuspend` cancels a pending leader and
  no-ops during 2-pick phases. While suspended the hook swallows a plain
  `q`/`Esc` (no Alt/Caps/Ctrl/Win) and dispatches `ExitSuspend`; the main
  hotkey also exits (App.ToggleOverlayMode).
- Guide window: per `Screen.AllScreens`, OverlayView DPI counter-scale
  pattern, **monitor-relative** drawing coords (review caught the
  absolute-coords bug for secondary monitors), `WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW` against
  Alt+Tab pollution.
- Item 9: single-instance mutex already existed but exited silently — now
  explains itself; `RegisterHotKey` returns checked (`TryRegister`);
  label/macro clicks via `InputSynthesis.SendMouseEvent` with 0-injected
  detection → `INPUT BLOCKED` badge (names the admin fix when hap is
  unelevated) + timing-log lines.

# Verification criteria

1. CI green (windows-latest MSBuild + vstest) after each commit — CI is the
   only gate from the Linux box; no local compile.
2. Unit tests updated/added: portrait 4×6, 24-letter landscape/portrait
   facts, `Classify` I-routing (plain/Shift/Ctrl/Win), leader default map,
   snapshot-closes-in-continuous VM test.
3. On-box manual checklist: see the report's verification section.
